narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The sum is divisible by three only when all three are multiples of three.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Four plus seven plus ten is twenty one, and three plus four plus five is twelve.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Neither set is all multiples of three, yet both sums are divisible by three.
